schematic.kind: software teaching index of source-defined textual regions; no original mole diagram claimed
schematic.orientation: Source left/right modeled as subject-left/right; source has no viewer or mirror protocol. Known frontal viewer transform is an explicit software convention,not Fontaine doctrine.

general_qualifications.description: Fontaine alleges that size,color,shape and hair change indications; his following entries concern middling size/color. No quantitative thresholds are given. This engine documents the qualification but never collects physical observations or computes strength.

terminology_conflicts: Inventory standalone Fontaine title remains unverified; actual containing work and section title are registered separately.
Inspected BPL scan: section starts p114; Gutenberg transcription marks it p115 and later pages differ by one. Never silently equate pagination.
Mouth points to Lips,p118->117; either lip means upper/lower,not proven left/right.
The wrist-to-finger-end range overlaps separate hand/finger entries; no automatic reconciliation.
No universal left/right polarity across regions or traditions is justified.
Software entry IDs and textual teaching index are not original numbered schematic labels.

conventions.selection: Exact software entry ID or region/side/location constraints; unknowns and contradictory selections are retained.
conventions.side: Subject-left/right by named software convention; no unsupported viewer transform for posterior/unknown orientation.
conventions.tradition: Only Fontaine/BPL1862 containing work; no Chinese or Indian mixing.
conventions.inference: Historical reference only; no physical measurements,personal photos,medical observations or individual conclusions.
